The Line Bumper Ottoman Divan Bed is a gas lift ottoman divan bed with a decorative bumper line headboard, handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The smooth end-opening gas lift base gives you under-bed storage, while the upholstered headboard finishes the look. From £324.99 in Single 3ft to £493.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Decorative bumper line headboard design
  • End-opening gas lift ottoman storage base
  • Premium upholstered fabric finish
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single (3FT): £324.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £402.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £415.99
  • King (5FT): £435.99
  • Super-King (6FT): £493.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Storage

The end-opening gas lift base lifts the platform at the foot of the bed to reveal the storage below. Keep the floor clear at the foot and allow headroom for the platform to open.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress. Our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress starts at £142.99.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone fabrics, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the base-only Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base, the Multi Mini Line Divan Ottoman Bed, or browse divan ottoman beds. Not sure of the difference? Read ottoman bed vs divan bed.

FAQ

What is an ottoman divan bed?

It is a divan-style bed whose base lifts on gas struts to reveal storage, here paired with an upholstered headboard.

How is the storage opened?

The gas lift base opens from the end of the bed. See how ottoman beds work.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

Is delivery really free?

Yes. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and usually takes 3–5 working days from our own team. Northern Ireland delivery is £90.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.

The Line Kids Velvet Bed is a kids bed with a clean panel line headboard, upholstered by hand and made to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. It is a simple, modern children's upholstered bed that suits Scandi-inspired or minimalist bedrooms, on a solid slatted base. Choose Kids Single 2.6ft (£285.99), Single 3ft (£311.99) or Small Double 4ft (£350.99), with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Clean panel line headboard design
  • Solid slatted base
  • Soft padded upholstered fabric
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Kids Single 2.6ft: £285.99
  • Single 3ft: £311.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £350.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home. Choose from the fabrics listed above.

Mattress compatibility

Pick the size to match the mattress you plan to use: Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft or Small Double 4ft. A bed frame only, so add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99 or browse all mattresses.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches mean your child can help pick the colour at home.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Which kids bed?

All of our kids beds come in Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft, so the choice is about the headboard. The Line Kids Velvet Bed (this bed, from £285.99) has a clean panel line headboard. The Mini Line Wingback Kids Bed (from £285.99) has a softly winged headboard with panel detailing, and the Line Wingback Kids Bed (from £285.99) is another wingback design. The Chester Kids Bed (from £311.99) has a deep-button Chester-style design, and the Mayfair Kids Bed (from £311.99) has a classic buttoned panel headboard. Browse all kids beds, or read our kids upholstered beds guide on how to choose.

FAQ

What sizes does the Line Kids Velvet Bed come in?

Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft.

Is it a good first big-bed for a child?

It has a solid slatted base, padded upholstery and a clean headboard with no fussy detail. Kids Single 2.6ft is the smallest size, with Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft for growing children.

Does it include a mattress?

No, it is a bed frame. Add a mattress in the matching size from our mattress range.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

The Linear Panel Upholstered Headboard is for anyone who wants a clean, modern look. Crisp linear panel detailing runs across the padded surface, lifting any bed frame or divan, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Linear panel detailing across a padded surface
  • Wooden frame with premium upholstery
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Five UK sizes, with made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Can I fit the Linear Panel headboard to a divan base?

Yes. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base.

Is it made to measure?

Made-to-measure options are available on request. Call 07417 439197 or email us to discuss.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
